Kim W: quick question  we just got a call: placement could happen any day this week. what's the minimum notice you need and what paperwork should I have in hand?
Anya (Benefits): congrats Kim! if placement is imminent, submit the parental_leave_request with 'flex_start: yes' ASAP. docs can follow within 30 days but send whatever you have now (placement letter, agency email). ideally give us 48h but we can work with <48h in emergency.
Kim W: perfect. will submit now. how do we avoid gaps in the top-up pay if dates slide a day or two?
Liam (Payroll): payroll uses code ADPT_TOPUP. if you file before the payroll cutoff (Fri 3pm PT) changes are seamless. under 48h we may need a small retro, but we try to process same-cycle if you email payroll@redwood.com and cc your manager.
Drew (Manager): Kim, I'll take on daily standups and own oncall for the first 2 weeks. please drop a 1-page "critical tasks" doc in the thread so I can hand off quickly.
Kim W: thanks Drew. also, any guidance for benefits like lactation support / phased return?
Anya (Benefits): company offers lactation support resources and a phased return option up to 60% for 4 weeks. mark 'phased_return: yes' on the form if you want that option. benefits counselor will confirm eligibility post-submission.
Kim W: do I need to notify my local HR (I'm in Canada) for provincial paperwork?
Anya (Benefits): yes please. international/local statutory differences apply. include your province/country on the form and benefits will coordinate with local HR to confirm statutory entitlements vs company top-up.
hr-bot: Ticket created: ADPT-1792500000. A benefits specialist will reach out within 1 business day with next steps.
Kim W: thanks all  submitting now and will upload placement email. will update here once done. :thumbsup:
